dct_description_sm: To measure air concentrations of semivolatile organic contaminants (SOCs) and gaseous elemental mercury (GEM) in background/remote locations in China to assess their transport from potential source regions in Asia to the Arctic.  To determine whether atmospheric concentrations and deposition of priority pollutants in the Arctic are changing in response to various national and international initiatives. To ensure the effective usage of information at the international negotiating table in order to achieve the appropriate restrictions on release of pollutants of concern for the Arctic environment.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Brominated diphenyl ethers
Health sciences and contaminants -> Persistent organic pollutants (POPs)
Health sciences and contaminants -> Atmospheric elemental mercury
dct_title_s: IPY INCATPA - Atmospheric Contaminants Measurements, 4 locations, China
